lede: The biggest thing on the calendar this week is the Telluride Town Council's three-hour budget work session Monday, where they'll grind through the 2027 numbers on enterprise funds, open space, and affordable housing — no formal votes yet, but this is where priorities get shaped. Ouray County commissioners also have a full agenda Tuesday, including a vote on opting into Proposition 123's affordable housing commitment cycle and a new intergovernmental law enforcement agreement. Norwood's Water Commission tackles the Cossey Complaint hearing and contract approvals the same day, and the Horror Show weekend is coming up fast.

notable.stake: Water rights hearing, contract vote, and dual executive sessions on legal matters.
